name: nucleophosmin 1

function.text: NPM1 encodes nucleophosmin, a nucleolar protein involved in ribosome biogenesis, nucleic-acid handling, and regulation of cellular stress responses and genome stability.

germline.text: Rare germline NPM1 variants have been reported in dyskeratosis congenita, but ClinGen rates the broader bone-marrow-failure association as limited. This is distinct from the established acquired NPM1-mutant AML context.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid sarcoma; Acute myeloid leukemia; Anaplastic large cell lymphoma, systemic. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
